item.title: 7 Palo Duro football players sign to play in college
item.description: Palo Duro High School celebrates five more football players signing to play at the collegiate level. PDHS now has a total of seven seniors signed to play college football.

item.title: Man indicted in Amarillo for burglary, kidnapping
item.description: One man has been indicted on alleged charges of burglary and kidnapping for an incident that occurred in November 2025.

item.title: Man arrested in Randall County for sexual assault of a child
item.description: One man has been arrested for three counts of alleged sexual assault of a child and one count of online solicitation of a minor.

item.title: Texans must prove legal status to register vehicles after new DMV rule
item.description: The board of the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles unanimously voted Thursday to pass new identification requirements.

item.title: 3 sentenced in 2024 shooting death in north Amarillo
item.description: The Amarillo Police Department reported that three people who were connected with the shooting death of Everardo Guadalupe Leal in 2024 have been sentenced.

item.title: Yellow City Rundown Feb. 9-13: City Council, Amarillo Lake fire, Bird Flu confirmed
item.description: On this episode of the Yellow City Rundown for the week of Feb. 9-13, we focus on what you missed this week at the Amarillo City Council, the fire near Amarillo Lake, and Amarillo Public Health has confirmed "non-negative" cases of Bird Flu.

item.title: Two Democrats, two paths: Goodwin and Vélez vie for Lt. Governor nomination
item.description: As early voting begins in the March primary, Texas Democrats are weighing two very different candidates in the race for lieutenant governor. State Rep. Vikki Goodwin of Austin faces labor organizer Marcos Vélez in the March 3 primary.
